text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I won! I WOOOOON!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I did it! Me! I'm a Derby champiooon!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket conquers the Japanese
Derby, the
race she's been dreaming of
winning since the
beginning!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And it was the race of a lifetime!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaah! Tic-ke-zo! Tic-ke-zo!
Tic-ke-zo!
Tic-ke-zo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! My fans!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for cheering me on! Thank you!
I... I DID
IIIT!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Damn... I lost!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(How did she do that? I couldn't catch
up no
matter how hard I tried!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Is that how strong she really is?)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu! And I'm just getting
started!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to show you all what dreams
are made
of, so keep watching me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Dreams...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(She's so genuine about everything, from
the way
she gets excited to the way she
celebrates.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Her presence is overwhelming...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket... It seems I misjudged that
explosive
power of yours.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, this is the last time I let you
win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I must recalculate my strategy right
away!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hey...

Sure, she didn't win, but she still made it
on the
scoreboard. That's an
achievement in and of
itself.
choice_data_list: タイシン、いい走りだったぞ
タイシン、いい走りだったよ
choice_data_list_en: Taishin, that was a good run.
Taishin, that was a good run.

text_block_list.text: Besides...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: クラシックはまだ終わりじゃないぞ！
クラシックはまだ終わりじゃないよ！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph. I know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to let anyone say things are over
for me
just 'cause I lost here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not when I still have the Kikuka Sho to
win!

The finale of the Triple Crown tour, the
Kikuka
Sho, awaits us next.

She reaffirms her dedication to keep
pushing on
so she can seize the next
crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I have to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: As long as I win, then one day...
